sources: arXiv metadata via the arXiv API (arXiv API terms of use; thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability), selected via the Hugging Face daily-papers listing
meta.method: 4PL grid MAP per model (g=0.25 for mcq) + per-cell grid posterior of tau with empirical-Bayes topic offsets (sigma_gamma=2, sigma_eps by moments); draws: paired cluster bootstrap of events within topic; hazard/abstain: two-level Beta shrinkage cell->model->pooled (5 pseudo-obs each) over items with t > tau + 2s
meta.note: DEFAULT index (2026-11-25). Model-level cutoffs anchored on the apoorvumang/knowledge-cutoff world events (kc, 280 events to 2026-06-30): a PRIOR for the 14 world-event topics, where GPT-6.2 Sol is freshest. The ai_ml cell is MEASURED on the AI-paper first-author probe set (210 papers to 2026-11-23, 21 fake-title controls; data/events/papers_events.jsonl, data/results/papers_probes_2026-11-25.jsonl): Claude Fable 5.2 is freshest there. Paper probes were asked as current_d and grouped with the kc direct probe as 'current'.
